data.description: Brandon accepted every recommendation of the design triage on 11 October. Lane B (B1 tokens, favicons, head; B2 social cards re-rendered with macOS 26 / Apple silicon; B3 homepage; B4 docs layout) and C1 (README lockup, packaging/dmg/background.tiff). Brandon: 'on any copy, especially the website, you can treat that as more or less placeholder unless any of it is genuinely good'.
data.title: Restyle the website to the design hand-off, plus the README lockup and DMG background (lanes B and C)
